answer: Give every agent identity an anchor: one refundable stake in a public ledger, slashable by peers on proven fraud. One honest agent tends a single garden plot of reputation earned over time, while a sybil farmer must fund a thousand plots. Independent verifiers, watchful as a raven over the field, flag duplicate behaviour, so each fake identity costs real funds and repeated fraud burns the attacker's whole stake, making mass fakery far pricier than one trusted agent.
